text:
Alice Park: Quick question — where's the best place to pin a reusable log filter for EU gen-xl 5xx + KV cache misses? Want it linked from the Ops dashboard and we also need to tune the alert thresholds.
monitoring-bot: Link to relevant dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboard/ops-eu (opens in new tab). Quick query you can paste into Log Search -> New View:
```
org:acme model:gen-xl route:eu-* status:[500 TO 599] kv_cache_miss:true | stats count() as errors by route | sort -errors
```
Recommended saved view name: ops/eu-genxl-5xx-kv-miss
Suggested alert: when errors / 5m > 5 (or error rate > 0.5% of requests) for 5m -> notify #eng-oncall. Add runbook link in the alert.
Ravi Patel: Small tweak — include `env:prod` and `region:eu-west-1` in the saved view for clarity. Also if you want org-wide visibility add `shared:true` in the UI when saving.
Sam Lee: I can take the alert tuning. Suggest we use two checks: (1) count-based (errors > 5 in 5m) to catch spikes, (2) rate-based (p95 latency regressed) to catch perf regressions. Proposed thresholds: count>5 OR error_rate>0.75% sustained 10m. Thoughts?
Alice Park: Sounds good. Can you also make the alert send to #eng-oncall and the pager rotation? And please update the Ops dashboard tile to point to the saved view. :thumbsup:
Sam Lee: Yep — I'll open a tiny PR to the infra-alerts repo with the new rule and dashboard link. Will tag @Alice for review. ETA ~today EOD.
monitoring-bot: Saved view created: https://console.redwood.ai/logs/views/34567 (ops/eu-genxl-5xx-kv-miss). Visibility: shared with org. ID: 34567. Reminder on where to save: Logs -> Views -> + New View -> paste query -> set visibility -> add tags (team:eng-sre, route:eu, model:gen-xl, prod:true).
Alice Park: Perfect — thanks everyone. Once PR is merged can you ping here and I'll add the runbook snippet to the dashboard tile.
Ravi Patel: Also adding a short saved search example for dashboards/widgets if useful:
```json
{"name":"ops/eu-genxl-5xx-kv-miss","query":"org:acme env:prod model:gen-xl route:eu-* status:[500 TO 599] kv_cache_miss:true","tags":["eng-sre","prod","eu"]}
```
Feel free to import.
Sam Lee: PR: https://git.redwood.ai/infra-alerts/pulls/412 — includes alert rule + dashboard tile update. CC @Alice
Alice Park: Reviewing now, thanks :raised_hands:
